import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
# path function: s distance -> (pos, heading)
R=20.0; L1=50.0; ARC=math.pi/2*R
def path(s):
    if s<=L1: return Vector((0,-L1+s,0)), math.pi/2
    s-=L1
    if s<=ARC:
        a=s/R  # angle travelled
        # center (R,0); start at angle pi
        p=Vector((R-R*math.cos(a), R*math.sin(a),0))
        return p, math.pi/2-a
    s-=ARC
    return Vector((R+s, R,0)), 0.0
TOTAL=L1+ARC+60
def mat(name,col,rough=0.6,metal=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes=True; b=m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*col,1); b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough; b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    return m
M={k:mat(k,*v) for k,v in {"Asphalt":((0.05,0.05,0.055),0.9),"Grass":((0.08,0.3,0.06),1.0),
 "CurbRed":((0.8,0.05,0.03),0.7),"CurbWhite":((0.9,0.9,0.9),0.7),"Line":((0.95,0.95,0.95),0.7),
 "Body":((0.05,0.35,0.9),0.3,0.4),"Accent":((1.0,0.55,0.02),0.4),"Glass":((0.02,0.02,0.03),0.1),
 "Tire":((0.02,0.02,0.02),0.9),"Rim":((0.6,0.6,0.62),0.3,1.0)}.items()}
def link(o):
    sc.collection.objects.link(o); return o
# ground
me=bpy.data.meshes.new("Ground"); bm=bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_grid(bm,x_segments=1,y_segments=1,size=120); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
g=link(bpy.data.objects.new("Ground",me)); g.location=(20,0,-0.02); g.data.materials.append(M["Grass"])
# strip builder
def strip(name,off_a,off_b,z,matnames,step=1.0,s0=-10,s1=TOTAL+20,seg_mat_len=None):
    bm=bmesh.new(); prev=None; s=s0; i=0
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    for mn in matnames: pass
    while s<=s1+1e-6:
        if s<0: p=Vector((0,-L1+s,0)); h=math.pi/2
        else: p,h=path(s)
        n=Vector((-math.sin(h),math.cos(h),0))  # left normal
        va=bm.verts.new(p+n*off_a+Vector((0,0,z))); vb=bm.verts.new(p+n*off_b+Vector((0,0,z)))
        if prev:
            f=bm.faces.new((prev[0],prev[1],vb,va)) if off_a<off_b else bm.faces.new((prev[1],prev[0],va,vb))
            if seg_mat_len: f.material_index=int((s-s0)/seg_mat_len)%len(matnames)
        prev=(va,vb); s+=step
    bm.normal_update()
    for f in bm.faces:
        if f.normal.z<0: f.normal_flip()
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=link(bpy.data.objects.new(name,me))
    for mn in matnames: me.materials.append(M[mn])
    return o
W=5.0
strip("Track",-W,W,0.0,["Asphalt"])
strip("CurbLeft",W,W+1.0,0.03,["CurbRed","CurbWhite"],step=1.0,seg_mat_len=2.0,s0=L1-15,s1=L1+ARC+15)
strip("CurbRight",-W-1.0,-W,0.03,["CurbRed","CurbWhite"],step=1.0,seg_mat_len=2.0,s0=L1-15,s1=L1+ARC+15)
# edge lines
strip("EdgeLineL",W-0.4,W-0.2,0.01,["Line"]); strip("EdgeLineR",-W+0.2,-W+0.4,0.01,["Line"])
# start/finish chequer
bm=bmesh.new(); me=bpy.data.meshes.new("StartLine")
n=10; w=2*W/n
for r in range(2):
    for c in range(n):
        x0=-W+c*w; y0=-L1+8+r*w
        vs=[bm.verts.new((x0,y0,0.012)),bm.verts.new((x0+w,y0,0.012)),bm.verts.new((x0+w,y0+w,0.012)),bm.verts.new((x0,y0+w,0.012))]
        f=bm.faces.new(vs); f.material_index=(r+c)%2
bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free(); o=link(bpy.data.objects.new("StartLine",me)); me.materials.append(M["Line"]); me.materials.append(M["Tire"])
print("track ok")

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
sc=bpy.context.scene
M=bpy.data.materials
def link(o): sc.collection.objects.link(o); return o
rig=link(bpy.data.objects.new("CarRig",None)); rig.empty_display_type='ARROWS'
def hull(name,pts,mat,parent=rig):
    bm=bmesh.new()
    for p in pts: bm.verts.new(p)
    bmesh.ops.convex_hull(bm,input=bm.verts)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=link(bpy.data.objects.new(name,me)); me.materials.append(M[mat]); o.parent=parent
    for p in me.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
    return o
# main body: wedge nose low, rear higher (forward +X)
hull("CarBody",[(2.3,-0.55,0.25),(2.3,0.55,0.25),(2.3,-0.55,0.4),(2.3,0.55,0.4),
 (1.2,-0.95,0.2),(1.2,0.95,0.2),(1.2,-0.95,0.7),(1.2,0.95,0.7),
 (-1.6,-1.0,0.2),(-1.6,1.0,0.2),(-1.6,-1.0,0.85),(-1.6,1.0,0.85),
 (-2.2,-0.9,0.3),(-2.2,0.9,0.3),(-2.2,-0.9,0.85),(-2.2,0.9,0.85)],"Body")
hull("Canopy",[(0.9,-0.55,0.7),(0.9,0.55,0.7),(0.1,-0.6,1.15),(0.1,0.6,1.15),
 (-0.9,-0.6,1.15),(-0.9,0.6,1.15),(-1.5,-0.75,0.85),(-1.5,0.75,0.85),(0.9,0,0.69),(-1.5,0,0.84)],"Glass")
hull("Splitter",[(2.5,-1.0,0.12),(2.5,1.0,0.12),(2.5,-1.0,0.18),(2.5,1.0,0.18),(1.6,-1.0,0.12),(1.6,1.0,0.12),(1.6,-1.0,0.18),(1.6,1.0,0.18)],"Accent")
hull("WingBlade",[(-1.9,-1.05,1.25),(-1.9,1.05,1.25),(-2.45,-1.05,1.3),(-2.45,1.05,1.3),(-1.9,-1.05,1.32),(-1.9,1.05,1.32),(-2.45,-1.05,1.42),(-2.45,1.05,1.42)],"Accent")
for i,y in enumerate((-0.6,0.6)):
    hull(f"WingStrut{i}",[(-2.0,y-0.04,0.8),(-2.0,y+0.04,0.8),(-2.25,y-0.04,0.8),(-2.25,y+0.04,0.8),(-2.1,y-0.04,1.28),(-2.1,y+0.04,1.28),(-2.3,y-0.04,1.3),(-2.3,y+0.04,1.3)],"Accent")
# accent stripe along top centre
hull("Stripe",[(2.31,-0.18,0.4),(2.31,0.18,0.4),(1.21,-0.18,0.71),(1.21,0.18,0.71),(2.31,-0.18,0.38),(2.31,0.18,0.38),(1.21,-0.18,0.69),(1.21,0.18,0.69)],"Accent")
# side air intakes
for i,s in enumerate((-1,1)):
    hull(f"SidePod{i}",[(-0.2,s*1.0,0.3),(-0.2,s*1.08,0.3),(-0.2,s*1.0,0.65),(-0.2,s*1.08,0.62),(-1.4,s*1.02,0.3),(-1.4,s*1.1,0.3),(-1.4,s*1.02,0.75),(-1.4,s*1.1,0.75)],"Accent")
wheels=[]
for i,(x,y) in enumerate([(1.45,-0.95),(1.45,0.95),(-1.35,-0.98),(-1.35,0.98)]):
    r=0.38 if x<0 else 0.34
    bm=bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm,cap_ends=True,segments=8,radius1=r,radius2=r,depth=0.32)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(f"Wheel{i}"); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    w=link(bpy.data.objects.new(f"Wheel{i}",me)); me.materials.append(M["Tire"])
    w.parent=rig; w.location=(x,y,r); w.rotation_euler=(math.pi/2,0,0); wheels.append(w)
    bm=bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm,cap_ends=True,segments=6,radius1=r*0.55,radius2=r*0.55,depth=0.34)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(f"Rim{i}"); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    h=link(bpy.data.objects.new(f"Rim{i}",me)); me.materials.append(M["Rim"]); h.parent=w
print("car ok")
